status.description: blocked - an answer of the coordinator or owner is needed; mechanism - your solution needs a protocol, timer or state that the analysis does not name: you stopped before the code with one line in prog.md (what and why), and the analyst gets one pass; environment - the red is the environment's, not the product's (a full run cut off before its tally, the slot queue refused your job - exit 77 or 78 - or your waiting process vanished without an exit code, disk or swap exhausted; a long queue while your process is alive is not one): the task stops for the coordinator

changedFiles.description: paths changed in this round (git diff --name-only from the start of the round)

head.description: git rev-parse HEAD of the worktree after your commits: the full sha (40 hex digits), not an abbreviation

mutations.description: table: mutant -> guard result -> after checkout

fullRun.description: result of your full guard run: N green, N new red (repeated alone), N flaky (green alone), N known red; when the workflow runs the full run (the prompt says so), "the workflow runs it" and the result of your new guards

acceptance.description: light mode only: the acceptance scenario run by you - result and where its evidence is (test.md, test-* files)
